CROSSING THE CHASM — leading her reluctant horse by the bridle across a swaying rope bridge over a mist-filled gorge, whispering calm while the planks creak and shift beneath their combined weight.
READING THE WIND — standing atop a weathered cairn with her cloak snapping behind her, holding a torn map fragment up to catch the last light, tracing the route to a valley that shouldn't exist.
UNEARTHING THE SEAL — kneeling in mud at the forest floor, brushing centuries of leaf-matter from a stone door carved with warning glyphs, her fingers trembling as the symbols begin to glow faintly.
FORD CROSSING — wading thigh-deep through a rushing mountain stream, holding her pack and bowcase overhead, each footfall testing for solid ground as the current pulls at her legs.
CHANNELING THE LEYLINE — standing with both arms extended at a moss-covered standing stone, eyes closed as blue light spirals up from the ground and her hair lifts in an unfelt wind.
CLIFF DESCENT — caught mid-reach on a sheer rock face, one hand gripping a root while her boot searches for the next hold, the valley floor dizzyingly far below.
HAWK LAUNCH — mounted on her horse at the ridge crest, her hooded hawk exploding from her raised glove toward distant movement, the bird's cry echoing across the scrubland.
ANCIENT CACHE — lifting a rotted leather cover from a hollow beneath twisted roots, revealing a bronze reliquary that hums with preserved enchantment, her breath catching at the discovery.
TRACKING SIGN — crouched beside a game trail, pressing two fingers into a deep track in the mud, reading the stride and weight of something that passed hours before dawn.
ROPE DESCENT — lowering herself hand-over-hand down a frayed rope into a sinkhole's darkness, pack swinging from her shoulders, testing each length before trusting her full weight.
SPELL FOCUS — striding through a dead orchard with one arm half-extended, palm glowing softly as her detection ward pulses outward, searching for the boundary of the cursed ground.
BRIDGE REPAIR — crouching at the broken end of a suspension bridge, knotting new rope to rotted supports, knowing she'll have to trust her work when crossing the ravine.
WOLF COMPANION — walking a narrow cliff trail with her grey wolf padding ahead, both pausing mid-step as loose stones skitter down the slope, listening for what dislodged them.
CRYPT UNSEALING — straining to push aside the stone lid of a roadside shrine, muscles trembling as the seal cracks and stale air rushes out, releasing whatever testimony lies within.
SCREE SLIDE — half-sliding down a loose slope on her heels, arms out for balance, using momentum to reach the canyon floor before the sun drops below the ridge.
FIRE KINDLING — kneeling beneath an oilcloth tarp while rain drums overhead, striking flint over a bird's nest of dry tinder cupped in her palm, each spark precious.
SEXTANT READING — standing on a basalt outcrop at twilight, holding a brass sextant to her eye, calculating position against stars while the known maps show only blank parchment here.
RIVER FORD — mounted and urging her horse into a swift river, gripping the saddle as the animal lunges forward, water surging past their knees, the far bank still impossibly distant.
SIGIL DISCOVERY — brushing desert sand from carved symbols on a buried archway, each stroke revealing more of a star-chart that matches no known constellation, rewriting what she thought possible.
PASSAGE SQUEEZE — turning sideways to press through a narrow gap between cliff walls, pack scraping stone, following faint light and air-flow that promises the slot canyon eventually opens.
SNARE SETTING — crouched at the forest edge, threading wire through a bent sapling trigger, working quickly before twilight brings out whatever has been taking travelers on this road.
RAVEN COUNSEL — striding across moorland with her raven perched on her shoulder, the bird's head cocked toward distant ruins, its agitation warning of something her eyes haven't found yet.
MAP STUDY — seated on a fallen column in overgrown ruins, unrolling a vellum map across her knees, comparing drawn towers to the crumbled stones surrounding her, searching for the vault.
BEAM CLEARANCE — gripping a collapsed timber across a doorway, bracing her legs to lever it aside, muscles straining, knowing the cache behind must be retrieved before the ruin collapses further.

ARROW FLETCHING — sitting cross-legged on a sun-warmed boulder, binding feathers to shafts with sinew-thread, replenishing her quiver while scanning the valley for movement before nightfall forces her to cover.
